title: Autonomous Navigation and Path Planning for Mobile Robots in GPS-Denied Environments
author: Ko Myo Min Aung
abstract: This research presents an adaptive SLAM-based path planning algorithm for autonomous mobile robots operating in subterranean and indoor environments without GPS availability.

title: IoT-Based Smart Energy Monitoring for Industrial Applications
author: Aung Kyaw Kyaw
abstract: This thesis proposes an intelligent IoT architecture for monitoring sub-station power quality and distribution loads in industrial campuses.
